title: llmcouncil v1 - synthesis envelope
description: Stage 3 response envelope returned by the Chairman. Normative contract; scripts/validate.py implements equivalent checks with the Python stdlib only.

answer_md.description: The council's final answer: complete, self-contained markdown in the language of the question.

consensus.description: Points the council agreed on; empty array if none.

disputes.description: Material disagreements between seats, fairly represented.

dissent_note.description: Optional; defensible minority view that lost. Empty string if none.
